key: A good family doctor in a small town greets
name: ch08_doctor_notes_patients
alt: A small-town family doctor glances at a notebook card before greeting a retired railway clerk about his grandson's exam and a farmer about the monsoon paddy.
scene: A warm interior view of a small-town Indian clinic, mid-morning. On the LEFT, the family doctor (about 55, white coat over a cream shirt, spectacles, stethoscope round his neck) sits at a wooden desk with a small steel bell and a stack of index cards; he holds one open card close to his eyes, and a dotted arrow runs from the card to a thought bubble showing a tiny graduation cap and a sprouting paddy plant. In the CENTRE, a retired railway clerk (about 68, grey hair, half-sleeve white shirt, old railway cap held in his hands) has just stepped through the curtained doorway and is beaming; a speech bubble from the doctor above him holds a small graduation cap with a tick. On the RIGHT, a wooden bench in the waiting area holds a farmer (about 50, white dhoti, green towel over the shoulder, sun-darkened skin) who is smiling as he waits, with a small bubble above him showing rain clouds over a green paddy field. A wall calendar and a ceiling fan complete the room. Bright, kind, homely light. Labels: "NOTES" just above the index card on the desk, and "FEELS KNOWN" over the centre between the clerk and the farmer.

key: A visiting uncle at a Diwali gathering in Chennai
name: ch08_uncle_learns_cards
alt: At a Diwali gathering a visiting uncle sits on the floor while his young nephew eagerly teaches him about a row of trading cards, while other relatives quiz a cousin about marks.
scene: A cosy living room in a Chennai home on Diwali evening, with oil lamps on the windowsill, a kolam drawn at the doorway and a string of marigolds over the door. In the LEFT and CENTRE foreground, a visiting uncle (about 45, maroon silk kurta, spectacles, slightly bald) sits cross-legged on the floor, leaning forward with his chin on his hand and an eager, curious face. Facing him, his ten-year-old nephew (striped T-shirt, shorts) kneels behind a neat row of five generic colourful trading cards with simple creature drawings and star ratings, holding one card up high and explaining with his free hand, eyes shining. A speech bubble from the uncle contains only a large question mark. Plain cards only, no brand marks. On the RIGHT background, two aunts in saris stand over another bored child holding a report card, one wagging a finger; this group is smaller and greyed slightly to show it will be forgotten. Warm golden lamplight, festive and tender. Labels: "REAL QUESTIONS" above the uncle and boy, and "MARKS?" over the small group on the right.

key: A college cultural secretary in Pune goes to
name: ch08_jeweller_cricket_photo
alt: A college student in a jewellery shop points at a framed photo of the owner with a cricketer, and the owner talks happily while her sponsorship file stays closed.
scene: Inside a small jewellery shop in Pune, seen from the customer side of a glass counter full of gold chains and bangles on velvet trays. On the RIGHT behind the counter stands the owner (about 60, cream kurta, gold-rimmed spectacles, round belly), arms spread wide and face lit up as he tells a story. On the wall behind him hangs a large framed photograph showing a man shaking hands with a cricketer in a generic team cap holding a bat, and a dotted circle with a small magnifying glass highlights the frame. On the LEFT, the college cultural secretary (about 20, yellow kurti, jeans, cloth sling bag, ID lanyard) stands at the counter with a closed blue folder tucked under her arm, pointing up at the photo with a curious smile. A speech bubble from her contains a question mark. In the foreground on the counter lies a small sponsorship form with two big green ticks, showing the happy result. Bright shop lights, glinting gold, friendly mood. Labels: "LOOK FIRST" above the framed photo, and "FILE CLOSED" just below the blue folder under her arm.

key: An insurance agent in Kochi has been dropping
name: ch08_agent_kathakali_headmaster
alt: Split picture: an insurance agent's brochures go unread by a retired headmaster, then the same headmaster happily talks about Kathakali and hands the agent festival passes.
scene: A split-panel picture divided by a thin vertical line, set on the verandah of an old tiled-roof Kerala house with coconut palms behind. LEFT panel: the insurance agent (about 30, light blue shirt, formal trousers, shoulder bag) stands holding out a fan of policy brochures, while the retired headmaster (about 70, white mundu, white half-sleeve shirt, spectacles, white moustache) sits in a cane easy chair reading a newspaper, not looking up; a small stack of unopened brochures piles up on a side stool and a little calendar with many pages shows the months passing. RIGHT panel: the same verandah, the agent now sits on a stool leaning in and listening, no brochures in hand; the headmaster leans forward, gesturing grandly, and a large speech bubble above him shows a Kathakali dancer's face with green make-up, tall crown and white ruff. The headmaster hands over two small passes. Warm Kerala afternoon light; the left side is muted grey, the right side warm and colourful. Labels: "BROCHURES" at the top of the left panel, and "ASK ABOUT HIM" at the top of the right panel.

key: A young chartered accountant in Surat wants
name: ch08_ca_munim_gatekeeper
alt: A young chartered accountant talks respectfully with an old head accountant at the office door, who then leads him in to a diamond trader's desk.
scene: A wide view of a traditional Surat trading office. On the LEFT, at a low wooden desk by the doorway, sits the munim (about 65, white cap, white kurta, spectacles on a string) behind thick red cloth-bound ledgers; he is smiling proudly because the young chartered accountant (about 26, crisp white shirt, navy trousers, laptop bag) stands beside him, bending respectfully and pointing at an open ledger page, as if asking his advice. A small speech bubble from the CA shows a tiny calendar with a clock and a down arrow, meaning faster tax filing. In the CENTRE, a curved arrow leads from the munim's desk through an open wooden door into an inner room. On the RIGHT, in the inner room, the diamond trader (about 55, cream safari suit, gold watch) sits at a desk with a velvet tray of tiny sparkling diamonds and a loupe; he is gesturing to an empty chair for the visitor. A speech bubble near the trader's desk shows a rupee coin with an upward arrow. Soft white tube light, calm, respectful mood. Labels: "RESPECT" above the munim's desk, and "SAVE A LAKH" above the trader's desk.

key: A long train journey from Delhi to Kolkata
name: ch08_train_three_worlds
alt: In an Indian train compartment a young traveller chats with an old tea-garden manager, a student and a soldier, each with a bubble showing their world.
scene: Inside a sleeper-class Indian train compartment, seen from the aisle, with blue berths, a barred window showing green fields rushing past, and a steel chai flask on the small table by the window. In the CENTRE, a young traveller (about 28, grey hoodie, backpack at his feet) sits on the lower berth with his phone face down on his knee, turned toward the others and smiling. Opposite him on the LEFT sits an elderly man (about 72, white kurta, woollen sleeveless vest, walking stick) talking, with a bubble above him showing rows of tea bushes on rolling hills. Next to the elderly man sits a college student (about 19, ponytail, purple hoodie) holding up a small wheeled robot, with a bubble showing a gear. On the RIGHT near the window sits a soldier (about 30, olive uniform, short hair) with a bubble showing snowy mountain peaks. Small dashed lines connect each bubble to the young traveller's head. A tiny note in his hand shows two phone numbers as scribbled lines. Warm, travelling afternoon light, friendly mood. Labels: "THREE WORLDS" across the top centre, and "PHONE DOWN" just below the phone on his knee.
